_comment: Perf baseline. startup + frame sections generated 2026-06-12 on linux-x64 and PRESERVED (their budgets carry deliberate CI-runner headroom; WO-210 re-measured them 2026-07-03 — startup 17.8ms, frame p95 0.50ms / p99 0.93ms on a quiet box — but a single quiet-run measurement does NOT justify tightening: the startup budget absorbs cold-import worst cases (~148ms) and the p99 budget absorbs GC-pause spikes (~27ms) that a lucky run never hits, so both stay as-is per the WO-210 brief's >=4x-CI-headroom rule). line section re-captured 2026-07-03 (WO-210) on a quiet linux-x64 dev box via perf:baseline; only transcript.append_one_ms budget ratcheted (20 -> 6) — it is the sole metric WO-209 improved and its p50 is rock-stable at ~0.9ms. Ratchet rule: startup budget = ceil(measured_max × 2); frame p95 = stated 16ms SLO; line budgets set just above measured with 2-4× CI headroom. Regenerate with: bun run perf:baseline (note: a regen on a fast quiet box will ratchet startup/frame down — restore those two sections unless the tightening is intended).

renderer_load_ms.note: Time to cold-import compositor + buffer + grid from a fresh bun process. Budget = ceil(max × 2), rounded to 50ms. Ratchet: tighten budget when measured_max drops below budget/2.

composite_p95_ms.note: Compositor.composite() p95 over 200 full-repaint frames, 80×24 synthetic content. Budget = stated frame SLO (16ms). Ratchet: tighten when measured drops below budget/3.

composite_p99_ms.note: Compositor.composite() p99 over 200 frames. Budget = ceil(measured × 4), rounded to 10ms. Ratchet: tighten when measured drops below budget/3.

transcript.build_1k_ms.note: transcript Line[] build (1000 mixed msgs). Gated on p50. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet (WO-210): tighten when measured p50 drops below budget/2.

transcript.append_one_ms.note: WO-209 win: append ONE message to a warm 1000-message transcript. The per-message Line[] cache reuses the unchanged 1000 and renders only the new one — the same rebuild that costs ~45ms cold (transcript.build_1k) collapses to ~0.9ms p50 and 96KB/403 objects (vs 71MB/695k). WO-210 ratchet: budget tightened 20 -> 6ms — p50 is rock-stable at 0.87-0.91ms across 8 re-measured runs; 6ms is ~6.7x this-box p50 and ~1.7-3.3x a CI-slowed median (runners run 2-4x slower). Gated on p50 (a robust median over 200 iterations — it does not spike on a single GC pause). A regression reintroducing the pre-cache full rebuild on append (~45ms) now fails the gate by ~7.5x.

transcript.resize_1k_ms.note: transcript resize (full width-change re-render). Gated on p50. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet (WO-210): tighten when measured p50 drops below budget/2.

panel.two_pane_build_ms.note: panel-workspace two-pane frame build. Gated on p95. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet (WO-210): tighten when measured p95 drops below budget/2.

markdown.render_ms.note: markdown render (mixed document). Gated on p95. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet (WO-210): tighten when measured p95 drops below budget/2.

codeblock.treesitter_ms.note: code-block render (tree-sitter cache-hit path). Gated on p95. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet (WO-210): tighten when measured p95 drops below budget/2.

overlay.open_ms.note: overlay open (help overlay frame build). Gated on p95. Budget carries CI headroom (runners run 2-4× slower). Ratchet (WO-210): tighten when measured p95 drops below budget/2.
